PHI.week7_result: L 21-38 vs DAL (Mon Oct 26, MNF). Eagles fall to 2-5. Tanner McKee 23/35, 211 yds, 1 TD, 1 INT in his second start. Saquon Barkley (back, compensating for hamstring) left in the 2nd half and was questionable to return; he said he does not expect to miss time. G Landon Dickerson was activated from IR and played, then blamed himself for a late sack. DeVonta Smith, Dontayvion Wicks, Nolan Smith, Michael Carter II were inactive.

qb.notes: Jalen Hurts is on IR (placed mid-October) with a DVT and bilateral pulmonary emboli; Rapoport reports ~3 months out, i.e. likely the rest of the regular season; earliest eligible Nov 22 vs PIT. McKee has started Weeks 6-7. Schedule file listing Hurts is wrong.
